c74object.name: el.dynss~
c74object.description:
el.dynss~ implements dynamic stochastic synthesis inspired by the model described by Iannis Xenakis in Formalized Music. Each waveform cycle is synthesized by linearly interpolating between a series of breakpoints whose time positions (X-axis) and amplitude values (Y-axis) wander probabilistically. At the completion of each period, the breakpoints undergo a random walk scaled by the devx and devy parameters. Setting higher point counts produces richer, brighter spectra, while increasing the deviation parameters destabilizes the waveform toward stochastic noise.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Signal input and control message inlet. Accepts messages to configure frequency, deviation, breakpoint count, and regeneration.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Synthesized audio output signal.

inlet.description: Receives messages to control frequency, deviation, point count, and waveform generation.

outlet.description: The dynamically synthesized stochastic waveform output.

method.name: devx
method.description: Sets the maximum random deviation applied to each breakpoint's time position (X-axis) per cycle. Higher values increase temporal jitter and pitch instability.

method.name: devy
method.description: Sets the maximum random deviation applied to each breakpoint's amplitude (Y-axis) per cycle. Higher values cause rapid timbre and amplitude variation.

method.name: freq
method.description: Sets the fundamental frequency of the oscillator in Hertz (default: 100 Hz, minimum: 0.001 Hz).

method.name: new_amps
method.description: Generates a new set of random amplitudes (Y-axis) for all internal breakpoints while preserving their current time distribution.

method.name: new_wave
method.description: Completely re-initializes the waveform by generating a new random distribution of both time positions (X-axis) and amplitude values (Y-axis).

method.name: pointcount
method.description: Sets the number of breakpoints in the waveform (clamped between 2 and 64, default: 6). Higher point counts increase the harmonic density and perceived brightness of the synthesized tone.

method.name: printwave
method.description: Prints the current breakpoint index, sample offset, normalized time position, and amplitude value for all active points to the Max Console.
